primary_authority_status: HUMAN_APPROVED_PER_USER; original pixels not yet locally verified for this package

terminology.physical_plausibility_means: coherent material response, depth, light and shadows within the approved stylized character design

style_approval_rule: Compare original-resolution source side by side against QA-passed golden frames. A prompt label or a technically valid render does not prove style match.
authority_conflict_rule: The latest executive style decision and explicit canonical identity invariants take precedence. Preserve historical approved artifacts even when an individual frame has a defect; do not promote defective pixels to a canonical golden reference.
freeze_scope: The vocabulary and visual direction are frozen. No claim of completed numeric geometry, measured palette, golden QA or production activation is made.
version_change_rule: No shot may silently reinterpret this style. Changes require a versioned decision and explicit human approval.
